findings.reason: the section overstates its schema work but names a true defect for one of the two; the description half of the section would be spent adding an existing property and its description-coverage number, already true on the unfixed code, cannot show the guard fires.
findings.text: §20 declares two schema changes and states "The installed plotting suite lists a description and a status for each pulse, which the import did not keep", but `Pulse.description` is already in `imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml` (attribute introduced at 5654dbf8a, before the pulse import) and the landed import preserves it — `create_archive_pulse(..., description=...)` in `imas_codex/config/codac_uda.py` is fed `item.get("description")` by `imas_codex/remote/codac_uda.py:311` and written by the pulse upsert; the landing commit 8db4796ff's own message says "Preserve ... descriptions" — so a node told to add the property and backfill descriptions works on a gap that does not exist, while the one real gap (status, absent from the reader's pulse payload) is one of the two named changes

findings.reason: the control as written can pass without firing, and the same section's sibling control was fixed to a constructed pulse for exactly this reason.
findings.text: the second negative control requires "a pulse the archive describes with an empty string" and no measurement in the plan or its evidence establishes that any such pulse exists (the trial fragment records 34 closed pulses and only that the seven *category* descriptions are null), so a run either skips the control or has to hunt the archive for a case that may not be there

findings.reason: the section needs the same private-file-plus-digest record it already asks of the §15 pre-registrations, or this measure reduces to a self-reported count.
findings.text: the done-when compares "twenty pulses chosen before the run" against the archive, while the same section forbids any real pulse text in a tracked file, so the pre-registration that makes the comparison meaningful has no stated durable record and a later reader cannot tell a pre-chosen set from one picked after the fact
